purpose: Bounded second-pass search for an exact, externally available IES or LDT. Exact means the same BVP353 LED count, L-size, 4000 K, optic and Dynamic DMX/RDM configuration; family membership or an 80 W L35 file is insufficient.

routes_checked.route: Signify global exact-product pages and their embedded download inventories
routes_checked.result: No exact IES/LDT. The locally preserved 150 W page sources have `photometrics:[]`; their download inventories name a product leaflet and visual/diagram collections only. The 120 W official page search result likewise lists leaflet/visual/diagram downloads, not photometry.
Confirms the exact 120 W and 150 W configurations are valid family members. The advertised family downloads are leaflet, installation instructions and visual assets; no exact IES/LDT was surfaced.

routes_checked.route: Web search of exact order codes and full configuration strings with IES/LDT/eulumdat/photometric terms
queries: "911401748533" (ies OR ldt OR eulumdat OR photometric)
"911401748623" (ies OR ldt OR eulumdat OR photometric)
"911401748173" (ies OR ldt OR eulumdat OR photometric)
routes_checked.result: Returned Signify product/family pages and manufacturer PDF leaflets, but no downloadable IES/LDT for any target.
No indexed results for BVP353. No file from a third-party index was accepted because none could be provenance-verified to the exact target.

outcome.closest_official_route: Ask Signify/Philips or the supplying distributor for a luminaire data package explicitly naming the 12NC/order code, BVP353 LED count, L-size, 4000 K, optic and DMX driver. Validate the returned IES/LDT header and integrated lumens before use.
outcome.rejected_substitute: Existing BVP353 36LED L35 80 W IES files remain optic-only carriers and must not be relabelled as 120 W/150 W data.
